intro.title: What are cookies?
intro.description: Cookies are small text files that are saved on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit websites. They allow the site to remember your actions and preferences over a certain period of time.

usage.title: How do we use cookies?
usage.description: We use cookies for the following purposes:

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: These cookies are essential for the website to function. They include user session, security and basic functionality.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand how visitors use our website so we can improve it.
analytics.examples: Google Analytics, visit statistics, user behavior

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Used to display ads tailored to your interests.

control.title: How to control cookies?
control.description: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies from your computer, and most browsers allow you to block their storage.
control.settings: To change your cookie preferences on this site, click the 'Manage preferences' button in the cookie banner or in the website footer.

more.title: More information
more.description: If you have questions about our cookie policy, please contact us via the contact form.
